title: Read-only triage of the task workspace, with a gated cleanup script
objective: Separate real open work from auto-generated noise in the principal's task workspace, propose a disposition for every open task, and prepare - but not run - the bulk changes that disposition implies.
resources: ClickUp workspace (system of record, not this repository)
human_gate: Principal approves the dry-run manifest, list by list, before any status change, move or archive is written. Deletion is out of scope entirely.
acceptance: An exact count of open tasks, reconciled against the 305 the principal's governance cites, with the difference explained
One proposed disposition per open task: KEEP, CLOSE-STALE-INSTANCE, RELOCATE, MERGE-DUPLICATE or ASK
The automation that keeps generating daily and weekly cadence instances identified, or marked UNKNOWN - closing instances without fixing the source only postpones the pile
A dry-run script that prints every change it would make and writes nothing unless run with an explicit --apply flag
Nothing committed to this public repository that names a list, folder, task or workspace identifier
next_action: Page every open task through the ClickUp API into a local, uncommitted file, then build the disposition table from it.
